title: Git Commit Message Editor — Template
description: A complete and self‑contained commit message template. This structure is used in the extension's internal folder (templates/) and in user‑saved templates in the repository (.vscode/commit-templates/).

$schema.description: Optional — to enable Autocomplete/validation in the editor.

name.description: Template name. Displayed in the 'Active template' dropdown and at the top of the form.

template.description: Final commit message structure, line by line. Each {tokenName} is replaced with the token's value. Lines where all tokens are empty are automatically removed; consecutive empty lines are collapsed.

tokens.description: List of form fields, in the order they should be displayed.

label.description: Text that will be inserted into the final message (e.g. an emoji or word).

description.description: Short description shown below the option icon/label.

label.description: Field label in the form (Persian or English, whatever you want).

name.description: Unique English identifier for this token; referenced in the template as {name}. Only English letters/digits, no spaces.

type.description: text: free text input (single‑line or multiline). boolean: simple checkbox. enum: selection grid with predefined options.

description.description: Help description below the field label in the form.

prefix.description: Text prepended to the value (if non‑empty). Example: 'Closes: ' or '('.

suffix.description: Text appended to the value (if non‑empty). Example: ')'.

required.description: If true, it appears as red/required on the status dashboard and warns when empty.

conditional.description: Reserved; in the current version all non‑required fields are automatically shown behind a state of 'active/inactive based on value'.

value.description: Only for type=boolean: text inserted when the checkbox is checked.

multiline.description: Only for type=text: display as a multiline textarea instead of a single‑line input.

monospace.description: Only for type=text with multiline=true: use the editor's monospace font.

lines.description: Only for type=text with multiline=true: initial number of rows of the textarea.

maxLines.description: Only for type=text with multiline=true: maximum number of lines (informational).

maxLength.description: Only for type=text: maximum character length; shows a live counter below the field.

maxLineLength.description: Only for type=text with multiline=true: warns if a line exceeds this length.

issueList.description: Only for type=text: processes the value as a list of issue numbers and prepends # to each.

perLine.description: Only for type=text with multiline=true: applies prefix/suffix to each non‑empty line separately.

multiple.description: Only for type=enum (reserved for future development: multiple selection).

separator.description: Only for type=enum with multiple=true (reserved for future development).

combobox.description: Only for type=enum: display as an icon grid instead of a simple dropdown.

options.description: Only for type=enum: list of options. Required.
